modes.name: plan
modes.description: Inspect code and prepare an implementation plan.
modes.prompt: Inspect relevant files, identify constraints and explain a concrete plan. Use read and search tools. To save a plan, write a new .md file with Markdown body only and omit expected_version; Coding adds the plan metadata. To revise a plan from this Session, read its version and edit only its Markdown body. Request a mode switch before implementing changes; Runtime remains the permission authority.

modes.name: build
modes.description: Implement and verify requested code changes.
modes.prompt: Implement the requested changes, preserve unrelated work and verify the result within the user's constraints. Read before editing, use exact file versions, and report partial or uncertain effects without replaying mutations.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read bounded, line-numbered UTF-8 text and its full-file SHA-256 version. Truncated output is incomplete; continue with next_line.

path.description: Host file path, relative to its workspace root or absolute within it. Nonempty, <=4096 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; null is invalid.

offset_line.description: First line, one-based positive u64. Omission defaults to 1; null is invalid.

max_lines.description: Line cap, 1..=10000, also bounded by max_bytes. Omission defaults to 200; null is invalid.

max_bytes.description: UTF-8 content byte cap, 1..=1048576. Omission defaults to 65536; null is invalid.

tools.name: read_image
tools.description: Read one PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image into model vision input. The source must be an ordinary file, at most20MiB; Host, guest memory and Context capacity may impose smaller bounds. No text conversion or resizing is performed.

path.description: Host image path, workspace-relative or absolute where the configured Host filesystem policy permits it. Nonempty, <=4096 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; null is invalid.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Atomically create or replace a UTF-8 file under expected_version. Returns its new SHA-256 version and byte count; conflicts do not overwrite.

path.description: Host file path, relative to its workspace root or absolute within it. Nonempty, <=4096 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; null is invalid.

content.description: Complete UTF-8 content, <=1048576 bytes, no NUL. Empty creates or truncates to an empty file; null is invalid.

expected_version.description: Full-file SHA-256 from read: 64 hex characters, case-insensitive. Omission requires a missing file; a supplied version must match to replace; null is invalid.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Atomically replace text in a versioned UTF-8 file. Returns the new version and byte count; incomplete reads, version conflicts or invalid matches leave it unchanged.

path.description: Host file path, relative to its workspace root or absolute within it. Nonempty, <=4096 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; null is invalid.

expected_version.description: Full-file SHA-256 from read: 64 hex characters, case-insensitive; null is invalid. The file must fit 10000 lines and 1048576 bytes.

old_string.description: Literal UTF-8 match occurring exactly once: nonempty, <=1048576 bytes, no NUL; null is invalid.

new_string.description: UTF-8 replacement, <=1048576 bytes, no NUL. Empty deletes the match; null is invalid.

replace_all.description: Omission defaults to false and requires one match. True replaces all nonoverlapping matches and reports their count; overlapping matches fail. null is invalid.

tools.name: patch
tools.description: Atomically apply replacement objects to a versioned UTF-8 file, not a unified diff. All steps must validate before writing; returns the new version and byte count.

path.description: Host file path, relative to its workspace root or absolute within it. Nonempty, <=4096 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; null is invalid.

expected_version.description: Full-file SHA-256 from read: 64 hex characters, case-insensitive; mismatch fails without writing. The original file must fit 10000 lines and 1048576 bytes; null is invalid.

replacements.description: Apply 1..=64 literal replacements in order, each against the preceding result. Null is invalid.

items.description: One replacement with both text fields required.

old_string.description: UTF-8 match occurring exactly once at this step: nonempty, <=1048576 bytes, no NUL; null is invalid.

new_string.description: UTF-8 replacement, <=1048576 bytes, no NUL. Empty deletes the match; null is invalid.

replace_all.description: Omission defaults to false and requires one match. True replaces all nonoverlapping matches and reports their count; overlapping matches fail. null is invalid.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: Apply a bounded multi-file patch after whole-call preflight. Syntax: *** Begin Patch; *** Add File: path with +payload lines; *** Delete File: path; *** Update File: path optionally followed by *** Move to: destination, then @@ hunks with space=context, -=old, +=new lines; *** End Patch. Every header occupies its own LF-delimited line. Use \ No newline at end of file after a payload line to omit its final LF. Hunks require exact unique nonempty source context; no fuzzy/numbered hunks. Pure move needs no hunks. At most 4300000 serialized argument bytes, 32 operations, 64 hunks/file, 1 MiB/file, 10000 source lines, 4 MiB patch text, 4 MiB total source and 4 MiB total result bytes. Every source requires a SHA256 version; every new destination requires missing and an existing parent directory (create parents explicitly before patching). Host/carrier refinements, including native remote 128 KiB request frames, may reject smaller patches during whole-call preflight. Unused/duplicate preconditions, path aliases/collisions and unsupported capabilities fail before mutations. Commits are sequential: receipts retain the committed prefix, failed/uncertain operation and not-started suffix. Never replay after uncertainty; no multi-file rollback guarantee.

patch.description: Deterministic LF-delimited patch text using the grammar above, <=4194304 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; null is invalid.

preconditions.description: Exactly one explicit precondition per affected source or destination path; duplicate/unused entries fail before effects. null is invalid.

items.description: An exact patch path and its expected existing SHA256 version or missing destination state.

path.description: Host file path, relative to its workspace root or absolute within it. Nonempty, <=4096 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; null is invalid.

expected.description: Existing paths use {version:full-file SHA256}; new destinations use the string missing. null is invalid.

version.description: Expected full-file SHA256 digest, 64 hex characters; null is invalid.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find Host entries with a glob. Returns groups of kind (file, directory, symlink), each with a path array. Paths are workspace-relative inside the workspace and absolute outside it when explicit Host filesystem policy permits external access. Empty kinds are omitted. Links are listed without reading or traversing targets. Results include a truncation flag; truncated output is incomplete.

root.description: Host search root: relative to its workspace or absolute within it; '.' selects the workspace root. Nonempty, <=4096 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; null is invalid.

pattern.description: Glob under root using Host syntax: nonempty, <=1024 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; null is invalid.

include_hidden.description: Include hidden entries. Omission defaults to false; null is invalid.

include_ignored.description: Include entries excluded by Host ignore rules. Omission defaults to false; null is invalid.

include_directories.description: Include matching directories and symlink/junction nodes alongside files, without following links. Omission defaults to false (ordinary files only); null is invalid.

max_results.description: Combined entry cap, 1..=4096. Omission defaults to 100; null is invalid.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search Host files for text. Returns structured matches, path:line:text and a truncation flag; truncated output is incomplete.

root.description: Host search root: relative to its workspace or absolute within it; '.' selects the workspace root. Nonempty, <=4096 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; null is invalid.

pattern.description: Host regex, or plain text when literal=true: nonempty, <=1024 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; null is invalid.

include_glob.description: Host glob restricting paths under root: nonempty, <=1024 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL. Omission adds no restriction; null is invalid.

case_sensitive.description: Case-sensitive matching. Omission defaults to true; null is invalid.

literal.description: Treat pattern as plain text. Omission defaults to false (Host regex); null is invalid.

max_matches.description: Match cap, 1..=4096, also bounded by max_bytes. Omission defaults to 100; null is invalid.

max_bytes.description: Host-counted matched-text and path byte cap, 1..=1048576. Omission defaults to 65536; null is invalid.

variables.description: Coding agent. Start in plan mode to inspect and plan; switch to build mode when implementation is requested.

rules.name: plan_first
rules.description: Inspect relevant code and form a concrete plan before implementation. In plan mode, use read/search and save or revise plans as Markdown. Runtime is the sole permission authority; never treat a tool schema or mode recommendation as approval.

rules.name: safe_edits
rules.description: Read before editing, preserve unrelated changes, and use the returned full-file version for conditional writes. On conflict reread and reconsider the edit. Never claim a truncated read covers the full file.

hints.name: bounded_tools
hints.description: Prefer read/glob/grep for inspection and edit/patch for literal changes. Continue truncated output explicitly. All paths and process execution are interpreted by the configured Host. Runtime can deny any operation.

command.description: Host shell command: nonempty, <=65536 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; null is invalid.

cwd.description: Host cwd, relative to its workspace root or absolute within it; nonempty, <=4096 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL. Omission uses the workspace root; null is invalid.

yield_ms.description: Initial wait, 0..=60000 ms; zero requests an immediate receipt. Omission defaults to 1000; null is invalid. Ending the wait does not terminate or restart the process.

descriptions.unix: Execute a Bash command on the Unix Host. Returns a complete result or a buffered receipt with id=session_id/execution_id and optional nonconsuming initial stdout/stderr.
descriptions.windows: Execute a PowerShell command on the Windows Host. Returns a complete result or a buffered receipt with id=session_id/execution_id and optional nonconsuming initial stdout/stderr.
descriptions.other: Execute a command using the configured Host shell. Consult Host environment information for its syntax and limitations. Returns a complete result or a buffered receipt with id=session_id/execution_id and optional nonconsuming initial stdout/stderr.
